title_zh: 拿着手机当麦克风唱歌
title_en: Funny Stories from Life (16/20): Singing into a Phone Instead of a Microphone
note_en: 到底 adds emphasis to a question, like "exactly" or "on earth": 确认手里拿的到底是麦克风还是手机 "check whether what he was holding was actually a microphone or a phone." English often shows this urgency with tone of voice or "actually," while Chinese inserts 到底 right before the part being questioned, and it pairs naturally with 还是 "or" in choice questions.
